coordinate_system: +Y up; +Z front; +X object right. Angles use local joint axes.
notes: 红、黄、绿灯按事件状态切换，默认不自动循环倒计时；图示顺序是状态比较。

states.name: 关闭
states.visual_description: All rocket indicator bulbs and blank sign backlight off.

states.name: 等待·红灯
states.visual_description: Only TOP round bulb on each rocket upright glows soft red, other bulbs unlit. Blank sign softly lit.

states.name: 准备·黄灯
states.visual_description: Only MIDDLE round bulb on each rocket glows amber; other bulbs off. Same blank sign.

states.name: 出发·绿灯
states.visual_description: Only BOTTOM round bulb on each rocket glows mint green; other bulbs off. Blank sign softly mint backlit. No added text.

generation_policy: 生成3D使用baseline中性造型，动态状态仅用于灯光/关节/形变设定；不对各状态分别生成模型。
reference_accuracy: AI概念关键帧；角度与关节约束以参数为准，不是同一3D网格的精确渲染。
clip_preview: 目录页的关键帧轮播，不是骨骼动画或物理动画。
